title: Source: OpenAI head of ethics Chloé Bakalar departs after less than a year, following exits by the head of safety systems and a former head of mission alignment (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Source: OpenAI head of ethics Chloé Bakalar departs after less than a year, following exits by the head of safety systems and a former head of mission alignment — Chloé Bakalar's departure is one of several high-profile exits at the group in recent weeks as safety concerns mount
